nom: Avène Retrinal Eye Advanced 3-in-1 Eye Cream

segments.sensitive: This is the dominant skin type in the reviews: most reviewers with sensitive skin, including some who normally react to retinoids, report no stinging, redness, or irritation, though a minority describe stinging, tearing, or a hard pass for very sensitive eyes.
segments.dry: The reviewer who names dry skin reports the cream provides the extra moisture her skin needs.
segments.mature: A reviewer who describes her under-eye skin as maturing reports it fits well into an anti-aging evening routine, alongside other reports of reduced crinkles and firmer-looking skin as reviewers age.

concerns.aging: Effects on fine lines and puffiness are mixed: some reviewers report a significant reduction in lines and firmer skin after a few weeks, while others, often at the same number of weeks, say they have noticed no real change yet.
concerns.dehydration: Hydration is widely and consistently reported as a strength, with reviewers describing the under-eye area as plumped and comfortable rather than tight or dry.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers who are usually prone to irritation from other retinoids specifically note the absence of redness with this formula, though a few report stinging or watering eyes on application.

aspects.libelle: Recent reformulation disappoints long-time users of the original formula
Pump or bottle can leak or dispense unevenly

Brightens the look of dark circles for many, though not all

extraits.titre: Huge Downgrade: Lux Price for Drugstore Quality
extraits.texte: This new 3-in-1 version is a completely different (and worse) product. As a long-time, loyal user of the original RetrinAL eye formula, I am incredibly disappointed in this reformulation. Avène is coasting on the high ratings of the old product, but make no mistake this is not the same cream. The Formula: The original had a rich, thick consistency with that signature creamy yellow hue that felt smooth and luxurious. It stayed where you put it. This new "3-in-1" version is runny, thin, and feels like a low-tier drugstore lotion. The Packaging: The downgrade in packaging is the most obvious sign of cost-cutting. It went from a sturdy, slim, high-end pump to flimsy, cheap plastic. For the price Avène charges, I expect a high quality experience, not a bottle with a cheap sticker that feels like it's going to crack in my travel bag. I actually dodged a bullet when my order for the .05 face cream was canceled, because if it's anything like this eye cream, the brand has completely lost its way. New users might not know what they're missing, but if you've used the original RetrinalAL formulations for years, you will immediately notice the lack of quality. I'll be returning this and beginning the hunt for a new brand. Avène, please stop transferring old 5-star reviews to this new formulation; it's misleading to your customers by using washed out reviews.
If you are sensitive at all around the eyes, this is a hard pass. Returned it after one use. Eyes kept tearing. Try the Roc retinol pen instead. No irritation from that one.

extraits.titre: Nurse, mom, multitasker… tired eyes are part of th
extraits.texte: I've been using the Avène Retrinal Eyes 3-in-1 Eye Cream, and I'm honestly impressed. Between shifts, early school runs, and everything in between, my eyes were starting to show it—fine lines, puffiness, and dark circles. This eye cream has been a little miracle in a bottle. It's gentle (no stinging or dryness), absorbs quickly, and after a couple of weeks, I've noticed smoother skin and a brighter under-eye area. The formula with retinaldehyde is powerful but still great for sensitive skin like mine. If you're juggling a million things and want one product that actually works hard too, this is it.

extraits.titre: My mature under eyes love this
extraits.texte: ✨Retrinal Eyes Advanced ✨ 3-In-1 Eye Cream -Helps to minimize the appearance of under-eye lines, puffiness, and dark circles. -Provides hydration & soothing around the eye contour -Helps to visibly brighten and even out the under-eye area. -Powered by physician-strength Retinaldehyde -98% Natural Origin Ingredients -Fragrance-Free -Suitable for all skin types including sensitive -Apply a small amount only in the evening to the eye contour and gentle pat in around the entire eye. -I've been using the Retrinal Eyes Advanced 3-In-1 Eye Cream for a couple weeks now and I really like it.It's super lightweight, absorbs quickly into the skin after application, and leaves the area feeling very smooth and hydrated. I've noticed less puffiness and a brighter look when I wake up in the morning . This cream is perfect for my maturing under eyes and it's definitely going to be staying in my nighttime skincare rotation.

Having used the Avène Retrinal EYES Advanced 3-In-1 Eye Cream for the past few weeks, I've noticed a definite improvement in the fine lines around my eyes; they appear softer and less noticeable, which is exactly what I was hoping for. As someone with sensitive skin, I really appreciate how gentle this cream is – I haven't experienced any irritation or redness whatsoever, unlike some other retinol-based products I've tried. I've also seen a subtle but welcome brightening under my eyes, making me look a bit more awake and less tired, although I haven't seen a dramatic change in puffiness. The cream absorbs quickly and doesn't feel heavy or greasy, making it comfortable to wear at night, and I like that it's fragrance-free.

I've been using the Avene RetrinAL Eyes Advanced 3-in-1 Eye Cream consistently for a couple of weeks now. While I appreciate the lightweight texture and how easily it absorbs without irritating my sensitive eye area, I haven't noticed any significant changes just yet. No major improvement in fine lines, puffiness, or dark circles so far, but I know these things can take time. I'm hopeful that with continued use, I'll start to see more visible results. Will update my review if that changes!

I have only used this for almost a month now. So far my under eye area is definitely more hydrated since using this product. I have dry skin so i need all the moisture. As far as wrinkles I haven't seen improvement yet but that takes time. All in all i do recommend this product!
